name: android_swipe
description: Quick flick from start to end (default 300 ms) that keeps scrolling with inertia. Use android_drag for sliders and precise moves, android_scroll for plain list scrolling. Give start and end as startX/startY and endX/endY, or their *Ratio / *Pixel forms.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

startX.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

startY.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

endX.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

endY.description: Screen fraction when both values of the pair are within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

startXRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

startYRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

endXRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

endYRatio.description: Screen fraction 0.0-1.0 (wins over the raw value).

startXPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

startYPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

endXPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

endYPixel.description: Physical pixels, even when 0-1 (wins over the raw value).

durationMs.description: Duration of the swipe in ms (default 300ms).
